scope: Unforced three-dimensional NSE on R3; fixed nu>0; real solenoidal Schwartz initial data; canonical maximal H1 strong solution.

definitions.trajectory: The same canonical maximal H1 strong solution U^{a,nu} is used in every charge and budget.
definitions.projectors: Six even Borel Fourier sectors, lexicographically indexed by permutations of (1,2,3), ordering absolute coordinates descending with increasing-index tie breaking.
definitions.six_charge_budget: J_6,A = lim_(r up to b_A) integral_0^r sum_(alpha=1)^6 q_alpha,A(t)^2 dt
definitions.enstrophy_budget: J_A = lim_(r up to b_A) integral_0^r Y(t)^2 dt
definitions.gauge: L_A^4 = 4 nu J_A = 64 pi^4 nu B_A
definitions.integral_convention: Extended nonnegative improper integral over the complete endpoint interval; no value at a terminal b_A is assumed.
definitions.fourier_convention: exp(-2 pi i x dot xi); gradient symbol 2 pi i xi

proved_b_tier: Concrete projections are orthogonal, resolve the identity, preserve real solenoidal H1 fields, and commute with weak derivatives.
a belongs to C^A_nu iff J_6,A < infinity iff T_max(a,nu)=infinity.

With the recorded A4 solution-class identification, Fefferman A iff for every nu>0 the class equals all solenoidal Schwartz data.
